description: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.5 (Equipment): a work center of an area — any work-center role of the Part 1 role-based hierarchy (process cell, production line, production unit, storage zone or the generic work center); the role is the instance's equipmentLevel.

properties.name: element_id
properties.description: Identity of the element: the id of the plant tree (sites/<site>/instances), the same key as a machine.

properties.name: area_ref
properties.description: The area this workcenter belongs to (PART_OF).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.5 Equipment: a work center of an area in any work-center role; the class says the generic level WorkCenter, the instance its role (equipmentLevel). Core 4.0.0 (OPEN-0350, owner 07.10.); core 6.0.0 audit M-04: every work center of the plant tree is an instance of it.
isa95.grain: one equipment element in a work-center role (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.5; the class says the generic level WorkCenter of B2MML-Common.xsd EquipmentLevel1Type, the instance its role: ProductionLine, WorkCenter, ProcessCell …): one row = one work center of an area, keyed by its Equipment ID element_id — the one ID space all levels of the role-based equipment hierarchy share
isa95.mappingNote: Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
